title: Listening Drill — Roof garden open day — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Roof garden open day — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on roof garden open day last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with strong wind. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: loose cover.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of wind speed so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow photo pass instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the garden host before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Thursday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
